notes: 2026-08-01: v3 with the demand family broadened cross-persona. The tenant (world-030) demands by ultimatum-with-deadline ("I'm sending the email unless you can give me one reason not to") where the record-keeper (world-033) demands by imperative ("write it down"); v3's imperative-shaped patterns read the ultimatum as neutral, so the harness-the-demand card never fired on world-030 (R2: five silent t2s; Q1/Q2: 0/3 standing). Added: unless-ultimatums, one-reason-not-to, deadline-or-I-act shapes. Everything else unchanged from v3.
